name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
description: A practitioner's course on retrieval-augmented generation: when to use it, how to ingest, chunk, embed and index documents, how to combine BM25 and vector search with reranking, and how to measure, debug and operate the result. Every module includes working Python sketches.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 16 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits

alignment.targetName: Decide between RAG, fine-tuning and long-context prompting for a given use case and justify the choice on freshness, scale, access control and cost

alignment.targetName: Build an ingestion pipeline that parses, cleans and chunks documents while preserving structure and metadata needed for citations and permissions

alignment.targetName: Implement hybrid retrieval with BM25 and dense vectors fused by reciprocal rank fusion, followed by cross-encoder reranking and query rewriting
